_comment: The alert queue: playbook step 2's shopping list. Top alert families by underwriter touches per month (verified census, 2026-08-02 recipe 'UW touches per alert family', Jan-Jun 2026, db 235). Readiness columns say how much of the machine's intake each family already has; 'unknown' means nobody has pulled it yet, not that it does not exist. Approve/reject mixes are from the single-alert cohort table (Study A recipe, Jan-May 2026, quotes whose ONLY alert family was this one).
